verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents its own proxy support: connecting to authenticated proxies, plus automatic retry with a proxy chain and fallback fetch. That lets a developer route crawls through residential or datacenter proxies they supply. Nothing in the evidence shows the product provides or manages premium proxy pools, and no hands-on evidence shows proxies actually getting past hard sites. missing for 10: first-party premium residential/datacenter proxy offering or tier selection, documented proxy rotation/geo-targeting depth, independent corroboration of bypass effectiveness

support.subject: As a developer, I can use premium residential or datacenter proxies to bypass sites that are hard to scrape

citations.quote: Proxy Support: Seamlessly connect to proxies with authentication for secure access.
Automatic retry with proxy chain and fallback fetch function
